text:
ana: Quick check  GA yardstick for Auto-Routing + Cost Controls. We need a concise GA checklist (SLA targets, docs + links, support/oncall plan, monitoring/alerts, pricing caps, rollback rules). Targeting next Monday. Who owns which item?

kevin: I'll call the SLA numbers. Proposal: Standard tier availability 99.9% with p95 <= 200ms; Premium 99.95% with p95 <= 120ms. Degraded SLA = 99.5% when routed to fallback for >10m. Thoughts?

ana: @kevin those are reasonable. Call out SLA measurement windows (30d rolling) and a clear degraded-mode definition. Also add a customer-facing note about expected behavior during degraded mode.

priya: For oncall/alerts I want explicit automated detection: fallback_rate > 3% for 10m -> P0, error_rate > 2% for 15m -> auto-rollback. I'll own the oncall playbook and escalation steps.

kevin: Good. We'll emit metrics: route_decision, fallback_count, fallback_reason, p95_latency_ms. Add an alert if p95 > 500ms for 5m.

miguel: Pricing: finops-bot can seed recommended burst caps for new customers. I also need an eng cost delta for the pricing page (expected unit savings). Can eng provide a conservative estimate by Thu EOD?

finops-bot: Recommended initial burst cap: 500k tokens/day for new accounts; scale-by-request with Sales approval. Template PR in finops-billing repo.

kevin: Eng estimate: after caching + adaptive batching expect ~15-25% unit cost reduction for typical chat traffic. I'll post the micro-bench numbers in the release PR by Thu.

sara: Docs owners: I'll publish the public GA FAQ + quickstart as ga-operational-playbook and link runbooks. Kevin -> runbook (internal+migration). Priya -> oncall/playbook. Miguel -> pricing blurb review.

priya: Adding a preflight smoke that must pass in CI before rollout. Snippet below:
```sh
# preflight smoke for GA
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":8}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/reply \
# assert: HTTP 200, body contains "choices", latency < 400ms
```

sara: I'll include that in the public quickstart as a note for partners migrating from older routing.

ana: Rollout plan: small canary (2% traffic, 6h) -> expanded canary (10%, 12h) -> partial (30%, 12h) -> full. Manual go/no-go after 10% step. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 2% for 15m or fallback_rate spikes > 10% for 5m.

miguel: Financial guardrail: enforce burst caps, bill-protection mode if a customer exceeds 2x baseline for 24h. We'll surface an opt-out path via Sales + FinOps review.

kevin: Can we get final SLA doc in Confluence and a short public blurb describing differences between Hosted/Dedicated/Private SLAs? I can draft the technical appendix.

sara: I'll draft the blurb and ping Product Marketing for copy. Miguel will confirm pricing lines.

priya: Oncall rota: Eng primary for first 48h post-GA, Support L2 handles triage; escalate to Priya if P0. I'll schedule a 20m handoff before rollout.

ana: Outstanding blockers: (1) SLA doc in Confluence, (2) runbook PR merged, (3) pricing copy + burst caps in billing, (4) CI preflight smoke. Owners: kevin, kevin, miguel, priya/sre. Can we close by Fri EOD?

kevin: Runbook + SLA doc drafts out today.

miguel: Pricing copy + finops PR will be up by Thu.

sara: Public docs draft ready Fri morning for review.

priya: CI smoke integrated by Fri midday. Will post results.

ana: If all green we'll schedule the 2% canary for Mon 02:00 UTC. If anything slips we re-evaluate scope vs date here. Thanks.

kevin: 👍

miguel: 👍

sara: 🚀
